speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please describe your gait and limb ataxia symptoms in detail, and tell me about the specific medical conditions in your history that led you to see me today.

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that description. Is your clumsiness on the right side constant, or does it worsen when you walk in the dark or after drinking alcohol? You mentioned a significant medical history; could you clarify if you have a history of diabetes, alcohol use disorder, or any prior strokes?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: PML (Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy) secondary to natalizumab therapy, likely with or without prior JC virus reactivation.

REQUEST TEST: MRI Brain with contrast. REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Brain T2/FLAIR sequences.

Please confirm if you have experienced any recent cognitive changes, vision disturbances, or headaches since starting natalizumab.
